## Professional biography

Guy Bavaro is a global advertising and technology executive who builds commercial teams and partner ecosystems that generate revenue. His experience spans EA, X/xAI, Snap, Microsoft and Yahoo across gaming, social platforms, search and digital media. He leads Global Agency Development and Advertising Technology Partnerships at Electronic Arts. His work combines advertising sales leadership, advertising technology business development, monetization, global agency partnerships, data and measurement.

## Aggregate career outcomes

Guy states that he has generated more than $10 billion in advertising revenue across his career and helped scale businesses from zero to billions. This is an aggregate career statement, not company-specific revenue disclosure or a claim of sole individual sales credit.
Source: https://gbavaro.github.io/executive/#outcomes

## Career experience

### Electronic Arts

Head of Global Agency Development & Advertising Technology Partnerships. Lead global agency development and advertising technology partnerships, connecting gaming audiences with agency investment, data and measurement partners.

### X / xAI

Head of Global Agency Development & Sales Partnerships. Led global agency development and sales partnerships at X, combining commercial team leadership, holding-company strategy and advertising technology business development. X/xAI describes the company context during this experience.

### Snap

Global Agency Development. Led agency teams, executive holding-company relationships, commercial negotiations and global activation. Worked with Product, Engineering, Finance and Sales Operations to connect advertising capabilities with partner adoption and revenue growth.

### Microsoft Advertising

Advertising Sales & Agency Development Leadership. Led advertising sales and agency development teams across search, video and digital media. Built agency partnership programs, developed leaders and negotiated commercial partnerships.

### Yahoo

Global Agency Development. Led global agency relationships, trading strategy and business development supporting agency adoption of Yahoo search and native advertising.

## Commercial expertise

### Advertising sales and commercial leadership

I build and lead commercial teams, develop leaders and establish accountability for revenue growth. My experience connects sales strategy, business development and partnership execution.

### Advertising technology business development

My advertising technology business development experience includes X and EA. I structure commercial partnerships and work across Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance and Sales to connect partner capabilities with advertiser needs and market adoption.

### Global agency partnerships and advertiser investment

I develop holding-company partnerships and joint business plans that connect executive strategy with agency planning, buying and activation. The objective is sustained advertiser adoption, investment and expansion.

### Data, measurement and attribution

I bring data partnerships, advertising measurement and attribution into commercial planning so advertisers can evaluate business outcomes and make informed investment decisions. This work connects partner capabilities, advertiser needs and commercial execution.

### Gaming and interactive entertainment

At Electronic Arts, I lead Global Agency Development and Advertising Technology Partnerships across gaming and interactive entertainment, connecting agency demand with advertising opportunities built around participation and engagement.

### Commercialization, monetization and go-to-market strategy

I help turn new advertising capabilities into commercial propositions, partner programs and repeatable go-to-market execution. My experience spans search, video, social advertising, augmented reality and gaming.

### Commercial leadership for AI and emerging platforms

For AI companies building advertising businesses, my experience applies to advertiser adoption, agency distribution, advertising monetization and commercial team leadership. For companies growing through partners, it applies to technology partnerships, joint go-to-market programs and commercial expansion.

Source: https://gbavaro.github.io/executive/#expertise
